Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

A completed drag now selects rows and rebuilds the timeline with its kept shaded span. However PlotBrushAdapter only handles MOUSE_PRESSED and MOUSE_RELEASED; it never handles MOUSE_DRAGGED, so no live shading is drawn while the button is held. The existing TimelineFxSuite checks the released/retained brush, not intermediate visual feedback.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/plot/PlotBrushAdapter.scala:65
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/plot/PlotBrushAdapter.scala:121
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/explore/TimelineFxSuite.scala:128

Remaining / next action: Handle drag motion with a bounded live overlay or builder update using the same plot transform; test shading after an intermediate MOUSE_DRAGGED before release, preserve final half-open selection and clear/cancel behavior.

Disposition: Keep open.
